display_long_description:
Cube Deluxe is a community-driven project made with the help of our fans and the same developers behind the original game released on itch.io. Inspired by Cube Runners and its different gamemodes, Cube Deluxe brings new ways to play, explore, and cause chaos.

Experience the Gamemodes

No Mod Stuff Mode: Play casually with none of the mod features.
Play With Friends: Enjoy Cube Deluxe together with your friends.
Mod Stuff Mode: Summon entities and experiment with crazy features.
Chaos Mode: Become the entities and cause chaos yourself.
Offline Mode: Play completely offline if you don't have anyone to play with.

Cosmetics

Buy and collect cosmetics to customize your character and make your appearance unique.

Horror Mode

Horror Mode introduces 14 brand-new levels filled with darker environments, terrifying entities, strange events, and hidden secrets. Explore every corner and try to survive what waits inside.

But there is more than just horror. Cube Deluxe contains secret lore hidden throughout the game. Look carefully, explore unusual places, and pay attention to the smallest details. You may uncover secrets that reveal what is really happening behind the game.

Can you discover all the secrets and uncover the complete story?

Play the game, explore the levels, summon entities, become the entities, survive Horror Mode, and uncover the hidden lore.

This game is approved by Tom Pearl.
